recipe.visualDefinition: A centered full-length portrait of a woman in a vibrant red dress standing in a dense, cool-toned field of low-lying foliage under a soft, overcast sky, topped with a horizontal band of stylized geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the warm red subject and the cool teal/green background
Vertical subject bisecting a horizontal landscape
Textual header integrated into the top margin of the photographic frame
Soft, diffused lighting creating a dreamlike, nostalgic atmosphere
coreInvariants: Dense, textured field of green/teal leaves

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, full-length figure occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red dress acts as the primary focal point against a muted background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the red figure, moves upward to the text header, then scans the texture of the field.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dense field provides a textured negative space that surrounds the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal and deep green (background field)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the central subject with low-to-medium saturation and dark values in the environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy greens and one primary warm tone

characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters to create a continuous horizontal line

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on the dark upper background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title, distinguished by spacing or slight scale shift.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text alignment across the top edge

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric aesthetic and tight kerning capability.
Provides the necessary geometric 'O' and clean monolinear strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-length photo of a woman in a long-sleeved red maxi dress with a black belt, standing in a vast field of dark green leafy plants under a hazy, muted sky. 1970s film aesthetic, soft focus, grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of thin, white, geometric sans-serif text across the top. The text should be all-caps with very tight spacing, almost touching.

verificationChecks: Is the dress a vibrant, solid red?
Is the text thin and geometric?
Is the overall image texture grainy like vintage film?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the red dress
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Strong color contrast between red and green

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible but thin
Check that the red dress doesn't bleed into the background
Verify the horizon line is soft and natural
Confirm the grain is uniform across the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Primary Color] + [Textured Natural Environment] + [Geometric Thin Header] = Vintage Editorial Style
